changes.nlPrompt: Add a new KPI "Direct Transport Costs % of Revenue" = cogs / rev * 100.

checks.detail: 2 operand(s) found in the chart of accounts (1 new)
checks.label: Accounts exist

proof.sql:
SELECT VERSION_ID,
  SUM(AMOUNT * CASE ACCOUNT_CODE
      WHEN 'cogs-mat' THEN 1
      WHEN 'cogs-lab' THEN 1
      WHEN 'cogs-oh' THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END)
  / NULLIF(SUM(AMOUNT * CASE ACCOUNT_CODE
      WHEN 'rev-gross' THEN 1
      WHEN 'rev-ded' THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 AS VALUE
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY VERSION_ID
ORDER BY VERSION_ID
